hero.title: Home maintenance, without the worry.
hero.lead: Huoleton tells you what your home needs and when. Maintenance tasks, reminders, costs and documents in one place.
hero.imageAlt: The Huoleton home screen: tasks due now, what is coming up and the full task list.

items.name: Plan
items.text: A maintenance plan built around your house.

items.name: Remember
items.text: Each task shows up when its time comes.

items.name: Document
items.text: Work done, cost, receipt and photos, all saved.

items.name: Track
items.text: Readings, costs and future expenses at a glance.

plan.title: Your maintenance plan starts from your house
paragraphs: Tell Huoleton the basics: year built, heating, ventilation and equipment. It picks the tasks that apply to your home from a ready-made catalogue.
Each task has a window, not just a single date. Gutters get cleaned in autumn once the leaves have fallen, not on a fixed day.
points: A ready-made catalogue covering heating, ventilation, roof, foundation, plumbing and fire safety
Every task comes with a source reference, such as Motiva or fire safety law
Add your own tasks whenever you like
plan.imageAlt: Huoleton app overview: the app logo, the name Huoleton, and the home screen on a phone in front of a house.

remind.title: See what needs doing right now
paragraphs: The home screen gathers what needs attention today, what is coming up and what is overdue.
Huoleton sends a notification at the right moment, and you choose what time of day it arrives.
points: Due, upcoming and overdue tasks grouped separately
Filter the task list: 1 month, 6 months, 1 year, 5 years or all
Reminders work without an internet connection
remind.imageAlt: The Huoleton home screen with tasks due now, coming-up tasks and time range filters.

record.title: Keep a record of the work you do
paragraphs: When a task is done, mark it complete in a couple of taps. Note the date, whether you did it yourself or a professional did, the cost and any remarks.
Attach receipts, photos and PDFs. Everything stays in one place, right next to the task it belongs to.
points: Date, who did the work, cost and notes
Spot a mistake later? Add a correction. History is never rewritten
record.imageAlt: The Huoleton completion form: date done, self or professional, cost, note and attachments.

track.title: Readings and costs, side by side
paragraphs: Follow recurring measurements, such as the water meter or underfloor heating pressure, and see how the values change over time.
The statistics show what maintenance has cost so far and where the money has gone.
points: A measurement history for every value you track
Actual and planned costs in the same chart
track.imageAlt: Huoleton water meter readings as a line chart, with the latest, lowest and highest values.
track.imageAlt2: Huoleton statistics: yearly cost chart, cost by category and measurement history.

pts.title: Know what upkeep will cost before the bill arrives
paragraphs: The long-term plan lists upcoming maintenance that carries a cost, grouped by year: ventilation filters, chimney sweeping and other recurring expenses.
You see the longer-term picture well ahead of time. Only tasks that have a cost estimate are included.
points: Upcoming maintenance by year, with a total for each year
See which years will cost more
Export the plan as a PDF
Free do-it-yourself jobs stay in the regular task list
pts.imageAlt: The Huoleton long-term plan: upcoming maintenance with a cost, grouped by year, with yearly totals.

features.title: Everything for home maintenance in one app

items.name: Automatic maintenance plan
items.text: Huoleton helps you build a maintenance schedule for your home.

items.name: Reminders
items.text: Upcoming tasks surface at the right time.

items.name: Keep a record
items.text: Log completed work, costs, notes and who did it.

items.name: Documents in one place
items.text: Photos, receipts, PDFs and other maintenance paperwork.

items.name: Measurement tracking
items.text: Water meter readings and heating system values over time.

items.name: Cost tracking and long-term plan
items.text: Actual costs and upcoming expenses in a single view.

items.name: Export your maintenance log
items.text: A service history for your own files, or for when you sell the house.

why.title: A well-kept home shows on paper too
why.lead: A house needs care for as long as you own it. Knowing what has been done, and when, makes every decision easier.

items.name: Small things don't slip
items.text: Filters, inspections and seasonal jobs get done before they turn into bigger problems.

items.name: You know what has been done
items.text: Who did it, when and at what cost. The answer is there even years later.

items.name: Warranties and receipts at hand
items.text: When you need a receipt or equipment details, they sit right next to the maintenance entry.

items.name: Selling is easier
items.text: A clear service history shows buyers that the home has been looked after. Print it or export it as a PDF.

items.name: No account needed
items.text: Start using the app straight away.

items.name: Works offline
items.text: Your data is stored on your phone.

items.name: Export everything
items.text: The whole log as a JSON file and a readable PDF report, any time.

pro.title: For when you want the log in the cloud and the whole household on board
pro.lead: The basic app works without an account or a connection. Pro adds optional cloud storage, if you want a backup or use the app on more than one device.

items.name: Cloud backup
items.text: Your log is safe even if you change or lose your phone.

items.name: More than one device
items.text: The same log on your phone and your other devices.

items.name: Shared household
items.text: Invite a family member with an invite code, and you both see the tasks and entries.

items.name: End-to-end encrypted
items.text: Your data is encrypted on your device before it is uploaded. We can't read it.

pro.note: Pro is optional. Your log works, and can be exported, without it.
